components.text: The Alchemical Reaction Chamber, or ARC for short, can function as a Furnace, offers a form of Ore-Tripling, and can revert certain crafted items (such as upgraded Blood Runes) back toward their component materials.

Should you wish to automate the ARC, you may want to know that it is sided, much like a furnace. Tools can only be inserted or extracted from the top, inputs from the sides, and outputs from the bottom. Keep this in mind when placing your Hoppers or Routing Nodes.
